# Vendored front-end libraries (offline, no CDN)

Downloaded once and committed so Sirens runs with no network.
Do not replace these with CDN links.

| File | Library | Version | Licence | Downloaded from |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| htmx.min.js | htmx | 2.0.11 | 0BSD | unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.11/dist/htmx.min.js |
| chart.umd.js | Chart.js | 4.5.1 | MIT |  unpkg.com/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.js |
| maplibre-gl/ (maplibre-gl.mjs, maplibre-gl-worker.mjs, maplibre-gl-shared.mjs, maplibre-gl.css, LICENSE.txt) | MapLibre GL JS | 6.14.0 | BSD-3-Clause | npm `maplibre-gl@6.14.0`, `dist/` |
| pmtiles/pmtiles.js (+ LICENSE) | pmtiles (PMTiles reader) | 4.5.0 | BSD-3-Clause | npm `pmtiles@4.5.0`, `dist/pmtiles.js` |
| mgrs/mgrs.min.js (+ LICENSE.md) | mgrs (proj4js project; lat/lon to MGRS) | 2.2.0 | MIT | npm `mgrs@2.2.0`, `dist/mgrs.min.js` |

Map assets outside this folder, also local and committed:

| Path | What | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| ../map/style.json | Street-map style, generated by `scripts/map/build_style.mjs` from `@protomaps/basemaps@5.7.2` ("light"), icon layers removed, local fonts | BSD-3-Clause (style code) | npm `@protomaps/basemaps@5.7.2` |
| ../map/fonts/*.woff2 | Noto Sans + Noto Sans Arabic (Latin, Latin-ext, Arabic subsets) used for map labels via MapLibre `font-faces` | SIL OFL 1.1 (OFL-*.txt) | npm `@fontsource/noto-sans@5.3.0`, `@fontsource/noto-sans-arabic@5.3.0` |

The map data file itself (`data/map/lebanon.pmtiles`, OpenStreetMap data © OpenStreetMap
contributors, ODbL) is not committed; `setup.sh` downloads it once (`scripts/map/get_map.sh`).

To upgrade: download the new file, replace it here, update this table,
then re-test the pages that use it with the network turned off.
